Name: Dirty Talking Sam Gives Rare Items
Author: Kagurahime
Description:
Update: Tested 5/7/2018 This mod is currently fully functional with the newest co-op update.

NSFW!

If you married Sam, this upgrade will cause him to give you a valuable gift almost every day.
He will randomly give: Iridium Bar, Gold Bar, Battery Pack, Magma Geode.

[b]Sam will also talk dirty to you. Very dirty. Not for kids. Like seriously.[/b]

Instructions:

Simply download the file, unzip and paste the contents folder in your main Stardew Valley folder.
When asked to replace files say yes.

Note. This mod will override any other mods that change what Sam says when married to you.
PS. This upgrade goes very well with the "Horny Bachelors" upgrade by girafarig, whose work I highly recommend!
